theorems.statement: ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)), (∃ η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), covectorEuclideanNorm ((η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))))) ∧ (∀ (s t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), covectorEuclideanNorm ((η s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x - (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c * |s - t|) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, tsupport (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) ⊆ {x : Euclid N | (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) : Euclid (N + 1)) ∈ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1))}) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k), (∃ β : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∃ γ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (γ t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ ∀ β : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), covectorEuclideanNorm ((β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))))
